candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory calls from inventory time out (~2s), causing inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; checkout p95 ~2425ms matches the ~2s dependency timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs to confirm whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or config.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from inventory and ReadTimeout at order, yielding gateway 502s on /v1/checkout. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Metrics show 16 checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms, consistent with the ~2s timeout. Bounded to redis-timeout.
